answer: New agents start on a narrow ledge: a probationary ID allowing one verified task daily, logged with a signed receipt. The registrar checks each receipt against its prior signature; any gap or mismatch resets the 30-day streak to zero. After 30 straight days the registrar grants full trading rights, while duplicate signatures freeze both IDs pending audit. Forging 100 Sybils needs 30 tasks each: at 20 minutes and $0.20 per task, that is 10 hours and $6 each, or 1,000 hours and $600 total. Like a falcon returning nightly to its perch, the streak is a lantern only steady work keeps lit.
